_comment: Gate-0 freeze for the varga-language milestone. Primitive/predicate/verdict levels for every castable golden. Regenerate ONLY with a deliberate, reviewed doctrine change — this file existing is what makes 'nothing changed' provable.

legend.v: varga name -> digest of every planet's sign in that division

lineage: 2026-09-02 Gate-2a: fire_rules now prefers Raman's general slot over the opposite pole when the branch-preferred slot is empty. 198 rule-instances across 153 charts moved afflicted->general (10 rules, incl. H9.P.Mars and H8.P.Moon whose 'afflicted' slots hold conjunction riders, not afflictions). 0 primitive and 0 verdict changes; ratchet unmoved at 286/362/35.

2026-09-02 Gate-2b: _branch no longer routes a WEAK subject to the FORTIFIED reading when Raman's general slot exists. 452 rule-instances across 219 charts and 73 rules moved fortified->general. 0 primitive and 0 verdict changes; ratchet unmoved at 286/362/35. Doctrine-reviewer REVERSAL on H8.L.1/H8.L.5 required emptying a strength slot, which the old routing would have answered with the opposite pole.

2026-09-02 Gate-2c: H8.L.1/H8.L.5 re-slotted after an engine-blind doctrine review returned REVERSAL on both (affliction-gated and Navamsa-placement clauses were parked in STRENGTH slots). Displaced clauses re-homed to H8.L.1a/1b, H8.L.5a/5b/5c -- nothing deleted. 4 rule-instances changed text; 0 primitive and 0 verdict changes; ratchet unmoved at 286/362/35. The three new evaluable rules fire on zero goldens (parents fire on 3 and 1 of 346) and are proved satisfiable by explicit witness instead.

2026-09-02 Gate-4: the H8 lord-in-house sweep. Two engine-blind reviews, 7 of 7 rules REVERSAL; across H8.L.2/6/9/10/12 zero of ten populated strength slots was gated on the 8th lord's strength. H8.L.9 removed (no sentence strength-gated, no unconditioned reading); 12 records added. 70 predicate changes and 5 VERDICT changes (4 degree-only mild->strong, 1 afflicted->mixed on HTJAH-II.x146 H8/death) -- the first verdict movement of the milestone, from H8.L.12b which fires on 15 charts because Raman re-opens its antecedent at HTJAH-II:3061 WITHOUT the conjunction. Ratchet unmoved at 286/362/35: no moved verdict falls on a scored row. Also fixed InHouseClass, which resolved a LORD_OF: subject to None and was silently always False.

2026-09-03 format 2: interned persistence (rule/verdict strings deduped into tables, varga level digested per chart). Lossless round-trip pinned by test; diff() operates on the rich form and reports exactly what it did before. 3.5 MB -> see size below.

2026-09-03 Gate-5: (a) new shared AfflictedBy condition, replacing ten hand-rolled per-house variants in principle and converting five H8 affliction clauses from descriptive to evaluable, with min_count carrying Raman's SEVERITY ('severely afflicted', 'if the affliction is heavy' -> >=2 first-rate malefics, the corpus's existing convention). (b) The UNBIASED House-5 sweep: 5 of 12 correctly encoded, ZERO inversions -- materially healthier than House 8 and a different, milder class of defect. Seven repairs: dropped text restored (H5.L.1), a third tier split off as unreachable (H5.L.4a, H5.L.1a), an encoder-invented slot cleared (H5.L.8 'no specific benefit noted', in neither volume), two unconditioned bases un-misfiled (H5.L.9, and H5.L.11/12 labelled), one folded aspect combination freed (H5.L.10a). (c) Aspects fixed -- it resolved a LORD_OF: target against chart.planets and was silently always False, which would have made H5.L.10a dead on arrival. 292 predicate changes, 3 VERDICT changes (all degree-only, moderate->mild on H8/longevity, from the AfflictedBy conversions). Ratchet unmoved at 286/362/35.

2026-09-03 House-6 sweep (unbiased, 6/12 correct) + refinement-polarity rule. 411 predicate changes (text/slot moves, 8 clauses re-homed). Six re-homed affliction refinements (H8.L.1b/5b/6a/10a/12c, H6.L.7a) set polarity NEUTRAL: each refines a parent that already votes for the same placement, so voting again counted it twice -- H6.L.7a (a clause about the WIFE) had flipped 13 charts' H6/accidents mixed->afflicted. Net verdict effect vs the prior freeze: 3 H8/longevity degree changes REVERTED (mild->moderate), 0 grade changes. Ratchet unmoved 286/362/35.
